title: Stage 0 Rerun Rulings — Chapter 10
lede: Two new framing decisions need a GM ruling. Previously adjudicated Stage 0 canon choices are preserved.
footer: Applied without asking: removed one out-of-character module-roster annotation from the Chapter 10 recap. Preserved five prior GM rulings. The unsupported chapter-number warning is logged as trivial. docs/background/obelisk.md was excluded with GM approval to fit the Codex CLI input limit.

items.t: Limit the abandoned-caravan passage to what the party actually established?
items.y: Edit summaries/010-20260821/session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well.md:18 to remove the unknown owners’ fate and avoid implying Wyvern Tor’s occupants caused the attack; retain that the evidence showed the Triboar Trail was dangerous.
items.n: Leave the current evocative wording unchanged and defer the report’s evidence-boundary concern in summaries/010-20260821/session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well.md:18.
items.ev: The transcript establishes an abandoned, apparently attacked caravan but explicitly leaves the attackers and owners’ fate unknown. See consistency_report_stage_0_gm_assist_codex_cli_door_rerun.md:6.

items.t: Replace the summary’s ‘already dead’ paraphrase with Hamun Kost’s actual conditional threat?
items.y: Edit summaries/010-20260821/session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well.md:22 so Hamun says that if protecting his secrets required their deaths, he would kill them; this matches the transcript and the quote retained later in the recap.
items.n: Leave the current ‘if he had wanted the party dead, they would already be dead’ paraphrase unchanged in summaries/010-20260821/session_2026_08_21_chapter_10_the_wizard_of_the_old_owl_well.md:22 and defer the quote-drift finding.
items.ev: The transcript wording is ‘If I wanted my secrets to be safe, I would kill you,’ which describes a secrecy condition rather than claiming the party would already be dead. See consistency_report_stage_0_gm_assist_codex_cli_door_rerun.md:11.
